in_sanskrit.name: अम्बर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is as vast as the sky, the one who is as clear as the cloudless sky, the one who is as magnificent as the sky adorned with stars, the one who is as powerful as the sky.

in_hindi.name: अम्बर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is as vast as the sea, the one who is as deep as the ocean, the one who is as vast and clear as the sky.

in_tamil.name: அம்பர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is vast, the one who is infinite, the one who is boundless.

in_telugu.name: అమ్బర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is vast, the one who is infinite, the one who is boundless, the lord of the sky.

in_marathi.name: Ambar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Ambar means 'Sky' or 'Heaven'. This name holds immense significance in Hindu mythology where the sky is often symbolic of the divine, eternal, and vast expanse of the universe.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sky, heaven
